# Source of these fixtures

Copied unchanged from the COSE working group's examples repository, <https://github.com/cose-wg/Examples>, at
commit `53c9d634333bb4f529d78f5980fffa2667ee2c12` (2024-03-13), on 2026-11-14.

Licence: the Unlicense, a public domain dedication. Its text is in [LICENSE](LICENSE), copied from the same
commit.

Why they are here: decision [0009](../../../docs/decisions/0009-cose-wg-vectors.md). `sign-tests/`, `mac-tests/`,
`hmac-examples/HMac-05.json` and `RFC8152/Appendix_C_1_1.json` and `Appendix_C_1_2.json` were added from the same
commit on 2026-11-17, for decision [0029](../../../docs/decisions/0029-several-signers-or-recipients.md).
